nodes.name: ErdosSzekeres.ctx_bound_additive
nodes.description: Additivity of the context bound (the open lemma of the induction, experiments 0120-0121): for every well-formed context, every partition of its child letters into a kept part and the rest (any interleaving), both orientations and every coupling d, the two part bounds sum to at most the bound of the whole. Tested with no violation on about 1.5 million interleaved partitions over eight parameter triples, including the k = 6 contexts where run-boundary cuts alone fail.
nodes.type_pp:
∀ (σ : ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Context),
  σ.WellFormed →
    ∀ (keep : List Nat),
      (∀ (p : Nat), List.instMembership.mem keep p → List.instMembership.mem σ.childPositions p) →
        Ne keep List.nil →
          instLTNat.lt keep.length σ.childPositions.length →
            ∀ (d : Nat),
              instLENat.le 1 d →
                instLENat.le d (instHSub.hSub σ.k 2) →
                  And
                    (instLENat.le
                      (instHAdd.hAdd (σ.part keep ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Side.lower d).bound
                        (σ.part
                            (List.filter
                              (fun p => Decidable.decide (Not (List.instMembership.mem keep p)))
                              σ.childPositions)
                            ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Side.upper
                            (instHSub.hSub (instHSub.hSub σ.k 1) d)).bound)
                      σ.bound)
                    (instLENat.le
                      (instHAdd.hAdd
                        (σ.part keep ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Side.upper
                            (instHSub.hSub (instHSub.hSub σ.k 1) d)).bound
                        (σ.part
                            (List.filter
                              (fun p => Decidable.decide (Not (List.instMembership.mem keep p)))
                              σ.childPositions)
                            ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Side.lower d).bound)
                      σ.bound)

nodes.name: ErdosSzekeres.ctx_bound_antitone
nodes.description: Monotonicity of the context bound in a sibling maximum: raising the longest chain of the sibling at any level does not increase the bound (every limit entering the recursion is antitone in the maxima). Tested on 9,444 comparisons (experiment 0121).
nodes.type_pp:
∀ (σ : ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Context) (l m : Nat),
  instLENat.le (σ.withMaximum l (instHAdd.hAdd m 1)).bound (σ.withMaximum l m).bound

nodes.name: ErdosSzekeres.ctx_bound_attained_by_end_cut
nodes.description: End-cut normal form for the context bound (experiment 0124 §2c): for a well-formed context with at least two child runs, the bound, which is the maximum over all interval cuts, is attained by a cut that isolates the first or the last child position, on some side at some admissible coupling. Interior blocks never win. Consequences: bound has a recursion over end cuts only, every cut tree normalizes to a sequence of end strips, and the exchange lemma behind additivity (the two-run boundary domination) becomes a commutation of two end strips. Evidence: every one of the 2,600 contexts with two or three runs and nonzero bound at k = 6 with up to four letters and two levels; the falsifier re-checks five cases.
nodes.type_pp:
∀ (σ : ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Context),
  σ.WellFormed →
    instLENat.le 2 σ.numRuns →
      Exists fun p =>
        And (List.instMembership.mem σ.childPositions p)
          (And
            (Or (∀ (q : Nat), List.instMembership.mem σ.childPositions q → instLENat.le p q)
              (∀ (q : Nat), List.instMembership.mem σ.childPositions q → instLENat.le q p))
            (Exists fun d =>
              And (instLENat.le 1 d)
                (And (instLENat.le d (instHSub.hSub σ.k 2))
                  (Or
                    (instLENat.le σ.bound
                      (instHAdd.hAdd
                        (σ.part (List.cons p List.nil) ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Side.lower d).bound
                        (σ.part (List.filter (fun q => Decidable.decide (Ne q p)) σ.childPositions)
                            ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Side.upper
                            (instHSub.hSub (instHSub.hSub σ.k 1) d)).bound))
                    (instLENat.le σ.bound
                      (instHAdd.hAdd
                        (σ.part (List.cons p List.nil) ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Side.upper
                            (instHSub.hSub (instHSub.hSub σ.k 1) d)).bound
                        (σ.part (List.filter (fun q => Decidable.decide (Ne q p)) σ.childPositions)
                            ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Side.lower d).bound))))))

nodes.name: ErdosSzekeres.ctx_bound_prefix_suffix_domination
nodes.description: Prefix/suffix domination in every context (experiment 0121 addendum 6, 0124): for a well-formed context, every nonempty proper partition of the child positions that is not itself a prefix or suffix cut, in either orientation and at any admissible coupling d, is dominated by a prefix or suffix cut in the same orientation at some admissible coupling d'. With ctx_bound_cut_le, ctx_bound_additive_prefix_suffix and ctx_bound_interval_or_complement_le this is both additivity conjectures. Generalizes ctx_bound_two_run_boundary_domination to any number of runs and covers the single-run sandwich. Evidence: zero failures on every partition of every context up to five letters at k = 5 and four letters at k = 6, seven cases, 155,472 to 288,408 oriented partitions each; keeping the coupling fails thousands of times.

                                        σ.childPositions)
                                      ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Side.upper

nodes.name: ErdosSzekeres.ctx_bound_same_size_exchange_counterexample
nodes.description: A genuine alternating partition of a two-run context beats every interval competitor that preserves its cardinality, orientation, and coupling simultaneously. Both the kept side and its complement are noninterval. This explicit witness rules out that restricted exchange rule; it does not refute unrestricted exchange or context additivity.
nodes.type_pp:
have σ :=
  { a := 4, u := 4, k := 5,
    word :=
      List.cons ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Letter.child
        (List.cons ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Letter.child
          (List.cons (ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Letter.ext 1 ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Side.lower)
            (List.cons ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Letter.child
              (List.cons ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Letter.child List.nil)))),
    maxima := List.cons 1 List.nil };
have keep := List.cons 0 (List.cons 3 List.nil);
have value := fun block =>
  instHAdd.hAdd (σ.part block ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Side.upper 1).bound
    (σ.part
        (List.filter (fun p => Decidable.decide (Not (List.instMembership.mem block p)))
          σ.childPositions)
        ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Side.lower 3).bound;
And σ.WellFormed
  (And (Eq σ.childPositions (List.cons 0 (List.cons 1 (List.cons 3 (List.cons 4 List.nil)))))
    (And (Eq σ.numRuns 2)
      (And (Not (List.instMembership.mem σ.blocks keep))
        (And
          (Not
            (List.instMembership.mem σ.blocks
              (List.filter (fun p => Decidable.decide (Not (List.instMembership.mem keep p)))
                σ.childPositions)))
          (And (Eq keep.length 2)
            (And (Eq (value keep) 4)
              (∀ (block : List Nat),
                List.instMembership.mem σ.blocks block →
                  Eq block.length keep.length → instLENat.le (value block) 3)))))))

                    (instHAdd.hAdd

                        (instMinNat.min
                          (instMinNat.min (instHSub.hSub cl 1)

Induction on IsDecomposableOn: split, transfer the context to both parts (ctx_satisfies_of_deepBelowSplit), apply the hypothesis, dominate the two-parameter coupling by the one-parameter one (ctx_bound_antitone), and finish with the additivity conjecture (ctx_bound_additive). nodes.name: ErdosSzekeres.ctx_satisfies_of_deepBelowSplit
nodes.description: Context transfer (experiment 0117, the union lemma): across a deep-below split of a child satisfying σ, the lower part satisfies σ with the upper part added as a level-1 sibling of longest cap capmax(upper), and the upper part satisfies σ with the lower part added as a level-1 sibling of longest cup cupmax(lower). Proved from the four-vertex law: mixed quadruples, chains extend by one vertex per side per level, strong sets join at one level. Verified on all 1,367,052 subtrees at n <= 8.
nodes.type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {S lower upper : Finset (Fin n)}
  (σ : ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Context),
  σ.WellFormed →
    ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Satisfies χ S σ →
      ErdosSzekeres.HasDeepBelowSplit χ lower upper →
        Eq (Finset.instUnion.union lower upper) S →
          lower.Nonempty →
            upper.Nonempty →
              And
                (ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Satisfies χ lower
                  (σ.part (σ.positionsOf S lower) ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Side.lower
                    (ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.chainMax χ upper Bool.false)))
                (ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Satisfies χ upper
                  (σ.part (σ.positionsOf S upper) ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Side.upper
                    (ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.chainMax χ lower Bool.true)))
